name: @skgo/sv
description: Native Svelte CLI add-on for skgo projects

scripts.build: tsdown sv-addon.source.js --format esm --platform node --deps.never-bundle sv --deps.only-bundle @sveltejs/sv-utils --out-dir dist --no-clean --target node22 --no-dts --minify && mv dist/sv-addon.source.mjs sv-addon.js && rmdir dist
